instructions: Compare the base and current text for one changed root section. Choose the single label whose criterion best describes the change. Use scope when the change adds, removes, or moves a capability, surface, or non-goal. Use behavioral when the result or a rule changes. Use clarification when behavior stays the same and wording becomes more precise. Use cosmetic when meaning stays the same and only wording, order, or style changes.

labels.name: scope
labels.description: Adds, removes, or moves a capability, surface, or non-goal.
examples: Spec Chat grew from the first change-type and orphan slice to also cover resolved-in-spirit, corpus, coverage, and reading suggestions. (spec-chat ANN-100 history, 65b767f)
Review assist moved out of the shared Jev contract and became ANN-100 work shipped in Spec Chat, while the contract kept the reusable rules. (annotateanything ANN-49 history, 3d6618d)

labels.name: behavioral
labels.description: Alters what the result does: a rule, interface, edge case, or criterion.
examples: A low-confidence answer now shows unsure, and a missing key shows one Jev off note instead of silently keeping the old state. (annotateanything ANN-49 history, 6378102)
Move comment here resolves the orphaned thread and starts a draft comment at the suggested section using existing events. (spec-chat ANN-100 history, 9453268)

labels.name: clarification
labels.description: Keeps the behavior the same while stating its meaning more precisely.
examples: The change-type section was rewritten as one Choice question with explicit criteria for scope, behavioral, clarification, and cosmetic. (spec-chat ANN-100 history, 42ee440)
The Jev seam boundary wording was tightened to follow the decision that removed the calibration gate. (annotateanything ANN-49 history, 2b6b529)

labels.name: cosmetic
labels.description: Changes wording, order, or style without changing meaning.
examples: The flow figure widened two boxes and moved a label so the diagram fit without changing the request flow. (spec-chat ANN-100 history, 42ee440)
The compared-range picker label changed from lean review (current base) to lean review (base). (spec-chat ANN-90 history, 88000ff)
